Source Singer Abhijeet Sawant recently opened up about the realities of winning early reality television shows. He reacted to Qazi Touqeers ongoing popularity inside the Bigg Boss 20 house.
 According to Abhijeet, reality stars faced immense pressure after winning their respective shows. He recalled how people often taunted them during the early phase of their journeys. Critics frequently questioned their whereabouts and claimed they had no future ahead.
 Despite past industry skepticism, Abhijeet expressed happiness over seeing his peers succeed. He noted that watching old friends grow and maintain their career longevity brings him genuine joy. 
 He also extended his best wishes to Qazi for his continued journey on the reality show.
 Reality television veterans often share a unique bond formed through shared public scrutiny. Their early experiences paved the way for modern contestants navigating sudden fame. Abhijeet highlighted that surviving the initial industry doubts requires immense resilience.
